title: The Tidemark Sails
description: Six flattened, keeled limestone ribs fan out over a shared stepped foundation.

review.notes: Round 3 (final, rebuilt). Fixed: two ribs now close into real arches with a dominant crossing, the feet have massive root bodies, and a small walkable arch with the figure gives scale. Not fixed: (1) the rib outlines are stair-stepped: each block edge sticks out as a small step, so every silhouette looks jagged, like a low-resolution sweep (hero.jpg, closeup.jpg right rib). (2) The free rib ends in a flat hammerhead cap (closeup.jpg left). (3) The root bodies are smooth, soap-like blobs with no coursing or breaks. (4) Material: uniform clean white with no localized weathering at the feet or joints; the joints are thin dark cuts. Fix: smooth the block transitions along the sweep, end the free rib in a broken or tapered capstone, course and chip the root bodies, and add local dirt at the feet and joints.
